difficulty_reason: Characterisation and stability of good acyclic modules: part (1) resolves the second factor by a good quasi-isomorphic module Q, uses that P tensor Q is acyclic, treats the cone N' of Q -> N (acyclic since the map is a quasi-isomorphism and P is good) and closes with the distinguished triangle; part (2) unpacks f^*P = f^{-1}P tensor_{f^{-1}A} A', notes f^{-1} preserves goodness and acyclicity because f^{-1} is exact, and applies part (1). Retained author proof at lines 3463-3498.
